svg.title: Analytical current and MVAr envelopes: STATCOM scales linearly with voltage; SVC MVAr scales with voltage squared.

g.text: 05 | Reactive capability as grid voltage falls

g.text: Analytical maximum-capacitive-output envelopes; both devices supply 100 MVAr at 1.0 pu voltage.

g.text: Assumptions: balanced voltage; no active current; no overload; converter remains within its voltage and control limits.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506477

g.text: Original calculated curves. These limits do not guarantee operation down to 0.2 pu; vendor low-voltage capability must be verified.
